## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Sep 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Joan Hughes_, Sep 9, 2026, 1/5: "i reviewed this app in June to say I'd used it for years, it was great, 5 stars but New update is dreadful! had to delete the rest to add that in the last 2 weeks its got even worse! heart rate monitor used to be fairly accurate but now it's useless. today my pulse was 120, watch said 66. Just when I need it most as I'm having cardiac issues it has failed. can't say how disappointed I am. would give 0 stars if I could. how can this happen?"
            2. _Kyler Sood_, Sep 9, 2026, 1/5: "I don't like how often they completely change the UI. The new UI is unintuitive and clunky, like it was made by an intern or AI. Edit: They made it even worse. App barely works now. I hope there's an open source tool so I can migrate my data to a new app which might actually work. UI is terrible - too high contrast and barely works. This app is super slow. I don't know who at Samsung decided to DOWNGRADE the app, I can only assume it was AI."
            3. _Hicks_, Sep 7, 2026, 1/5: "The app updated by Samsung requires One UI 9 on the watch - this will only be distributed over time. Until then, you have to expect bugs. In the end, the only thing that helps is reinstalling the app - synchronization now works again for me. @Samsung: Great IT performance!! First lay the water pipe and then take care of the connections. The stupid user wastes his time skimming."
